_comment: Per-app contracts for `lume screenshot --scan N`. roi is the canvas region (screen coords, 480x480) in which changed pixels are measured. layers are static canvas geometry that must be present in EVERY frame (expected layer set); minInk is calibrated from an esp32sim capture. dynamicRegion bounds where frame-to-frame changes are allowed; changed pixels may never intrude into a layer ROI. start/step are the deterministic esp32sim --max-seconds samples (fixed firmware + fixed app frame + fixed script). scriptLines are extra host actions appended after the 2.5s serial-file injection.
